text:
Alex (Procurement): @Anita quick one — the renewal for BudgetPilot came through. Can you confirm the committed vs overage pricing and whether invoices can show line items for committed blocks?

Anita - BudgetPilot: hi! yes — happy to clarify. For the 12mo commit we quoted 18% off list. Invoices can show: committed hours, overage hours, and any add-ons as separate line items.

Maria (Finance): can you confirm invoicing cadence? we need monthly invoices and PO number on each. Also need VAT handling for EU entities.

Anita - BudgetPilot: monthly invoices are fine. We support PO on invoice and VAT as separate tax lines. We can also include a GL code field if you provide the mapping.

Sam (Payments): do you support SFTP delivery or webhook for invoices? We prefer SFTP pull and an emailed PDF. Also need a billing contact for remittance.

Anita - BudgetPilot: SFTP + email PDF supported. Send creds for the SFTP and we'll push there. Billing contact ok — include name/email and we’ll cc them.

Rachel (Legal): got a couple of contract asks — can we add an explicit monthly reconciliation window (30 days) for usage disputes, and a hard cap on overage increases (so monthly overage won't spike >50% of committed rate without 60 days notice)?

Anita - BudgetPilot: we can do a 30-day dispute window. For overage caps we usually do tiered pricing, but I can propose an addendum: 60-day notice for >50% step changes. I'll flag with legal.

Alex (Procurement): please add that clause to the SOW. Also we need line items broken down by product (inference, embeddings, storage) — can BudgetPilot include product-level usage?

Anita - BudgetPilot: yes. Example invoice sample below (we'll fill numeric values for you):

```
Period: 2026-06-01 to 2026-06-30
1) Committed Inference Hours (1000h) - $12,000
2) Overage Inference Hours (200h @ $15/h) - $3,000
3) Embeddings (10M units) - $1,500
4) Storage (TB-months) - $200
Tax: $1,350
Total: $18,050
Notes: PO# REQUIRED-12345
```

Maria (Finance): that layout works. One more — can you add a billing-friendly memo with GL code and cost center per invoice line? we need that for our AR automation.

Anita - BudgetPilot: yes we can add a free-text memo and a structured GL field per line. Provide the field names you ingest and we'll map.

Alex (Procurement): procurement timeline — how long to get the amended SOW and formal quote? We want to finalize before end of month.

Anita - BudgetPilot: I can have a revised SOW and updated quote by EOD Friday. Will include: 12mo commitment, 18% discount, 30-day dispute window, 60-day notice for >50% overage step, monthly invoices with product-level line items and GL fields.

Sam (Payments): will BudgetPilot accept net-45 on the first year with a corporate card on file for emergency?

Anita - BudgetPilot: standard is net-30, but we can make net-45 for a 12mo commit. Corporate card as backup is fine.

Rachel (Legal): also please confirm auto-renew behavior and termination rights — we require a 60-day opt-out notice before renewal.

Anita - BudgetPilot: we'll mark auto-renew with 60-day opt-out and include a clause for early-termination fees (prorated based on remaining committed months).

Alex (Procurement): perfect. @Maria @Sam any red flags from finance/payments?

Maria (Finance): all good pending the SOW. please cc finance@redwood.ai on the doc.

Sam (Payments): SFTP details to payments@redwood.ai. Card backup noted.

Anita - BudgetPilot: thanks — I'll send the SOW to legal@redwood.ai, finance@redwood.ai, and procurement@redwood.ai by Friday EOD.

billing-bot: Invoice 2026-06-demo-sample.pdf uploaded to /invoices/budgetpilot/ (automated note) :page_with_curl:

Alex (Procurement): thanks everyone. We'll review once SOW lands. :thumbsup:
